title: Let Us Make Bricks
text: Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly.

title: A Name for Ourselves
text: … that we may make a name for ourselves and not be scattered over the face of all the earth.

title: The LORD Came Down
text: Then the LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men were building.

title: Scattered
text: So the LORD scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they stopped building the city.

title: Babel
text: That is why it is called Babel, for there the LORD confused the language of the whole world …

title: Tar Instead of Mortar
text: … So they used brick instead of stone, and tar instead of mortar.

title: The Land of Shinar
text: And as people journeyed eastward, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.

title: The Nations Spread Out
text: … From these the nations of the earth spread out after the flood.

title: Pride Goes Before a Fall
text: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.

title: The Plans of the Nations
text: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.
